source: Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India: Census 2011, Table C-17 (bilingualism and trilingualism), as on 1 March 2011, over population from Table A-01. Telangana and Ladakh sit inside Andhra Pradesh and Jammu and Kashmir as counted in 2011.
